intro: Tuvalu earns money from fishing licences and its '.tv' internet domain.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Tuvalu's '.tv' web address is leased to companies and brings in a big share of income. Fishing licences for its waters are another main source.

chapters.title: Trust fund
text: A national trust fund helps pay for government services.

keyTerms.meaning: The ending of a web address, like .tv.

cardGroups.title: Made in Tuvalu
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Tuvalu makes and sells to the world.
